dataset: Archived parallel bounded stress schedule observations
release: selected-field public transcription of archived internal schedule records
scope: four bounded parallel probes (engine API, local TCP, resource pressure, process termination); NOT end-to-end journal corruption/reconciliation proof
timing_note: Relative per-schedule timing in milliseconds derived from source monotonic timestamps and rounded to 0.001 ms; 4-way overlap recomputed from those public timing windows.
privacy_note: Host timestamps, file paths, command arguments, resource tuning, internal source identifiers and implementation details were excluded.
